# algeria-melbet.com

algeria-melbet.com publishes two public landing pages for Algeria. The homepage covers live football, casino games, offers, rewards, and mobile-first access. The partnership page covers benefits, onboarding steps, partnership models, reporting, and contact paths. The visible interface supports English, French, and Arabic on the same public URLs.

## Canonical pages
- https://algeria-melbet.com/
  Homepage for live football, casino games, offers, and rewards on mobile.
- https://algeria-melbet.com/partnership/
  Partnership page for benefits, onboarding, reporting, and contact routes.

## Site notes
- Public pages are visitor-facing landing pages.
- Primary audiences are players on the homepage and prospective partners on the partnership page.
- The same public URLs support English, French, and Arabic content in the interface.

- Sitemap: https://algeria-melbet.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://algeria-melbet.com/robots.txt
